package.name: rovo_fake_pico
package.description: UDP-to-Twist bridge that emulates the Rovo on-board Pico controller. Listens on UDP port 8887 for packets emitted by gcs_cmd_vel.py, decodes the LRPM/RRPM (VEL mode) or FWD/TURN (XY mode) fields and republishes the equivalent geometry_msgs/Twist on /cmd_vel_gcs so the simulated robot reacts identically to the real hardware path.
